objective: Determine the origin of the red diagonal lines appearing on the login screen.
evidence: Extensive code search revealed no references to debug painting, custom painters drawing lines, or any obvious source of red lines in the Dart code. The tutorial overlay and other overlays were inspected and do not draw diagonal red lines. Asset paths were verified and images load correctly. No evidence of Flutter debug flags (debugPaintSizeEnabled, etc.) was found. The anomaly persists despite no code changes.
search_performed: Search for debugPaintSizeEnabled, debugPaintBaselinesEnabled, debugPaintPointersEnabled, showPerformanceOverlay, checkerboard, debugPaint, debugRepaintRainbowEnabled, drawLine, CustomPaint, CustomPainter, Canvas, Paint, Colors.red, Color.red, Border, Border.all, Overlay, OverlayEntry, GestureDetector, Stack, Positioned, CustomPainter subclasses, and any use of red color in paints or borders. Also inspected web assets for possible CSS or SVG sources.
cause: Unable to determine the cause of the red diagonal lines from the available codebase and resources.
impact: Visual anomaly only; does not appear to affect functionality based on user report.
recommendation: Further investigation with Flutter DevTools overlay enabled or checking for browser extensions/devtools that might be drawing the lines is recommended. Since no code changes are allowed per the audit constraints, the source remains undetermined.
status_final: SOURCE_NOT_DETERMINED - No actionable origin found within the constraints of the audit.
